name: ref-service-drift
displayName: REF - Critical service drift or restart failure
description: Watchdog event 1000 (a critical service drifted from its enforced state) or 1001 (a critical service could not be restarted). Routine dmwappushservice demand-start cycling is excluded from 1000; 1001 is never excluded.

criteria.query: Event | where ingestion_time() > ago(5m) | where EventLog == "REF" | where EventID in (1000, 1001) | where not(EventID == 1000 and RenderedDescription has "dmwappushservice") | extend LocalTime = format_datetime(datetime_utc_to_local(TimeGenerated,"America/Los_Angeles"),"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss") | project LocalTime, Computer, EventID, Detail=substring(RenderedDescription,0,600)
